page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.16xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 64-vCPU dedicated allocation of x86_64 Intel Xeon 6462C processors running at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance configuration pairs this high-frequency compute capacity with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio.

For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. It contains no onboard local storage, requiring external cloud block storage for persistent and temporary file systems. Furthermore, the instance does not feature dedicated GPU acceleration hardware and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio and 3.3 GHz processor frequency, the ecs.hfr8i.16xlarge combines properties of both compute and memory configurations. This profile aligns with workloads demanding substantial memory footprints alongside rapid per-core execution speeds, including in-memory relational and non-relational database deployments, real-time analytics pipelines, and memory-bound enterprise systems.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.16xlarge is a dedicated KVM-based cloud instance within the High Clock Speed family, featuring 64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 6462C processors clocked at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 512.0 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per core memory allocation that provides substantial capacity for memory-intensive operations alongside elevated single-thread clock frequencies. Network throughput is provisioned with a 64 Gbps baseline, facilitating high data interchange between distributed infrastructure components. The configuration contains no local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for system and runtime data. The hardware profile is geared toward compute and memory density, making it suitable for enterprise database engines, in-memory caching solutions, high-throughput batch transaction systems, and demanding enterprise software suites that balance raw CPU frequency with large working memory spaces.
